Grace wrote about the day in the diary. There are always many people at the supermarket. The shopping mall is one of the best places in the city. Free shipping takes a day longer.
Grace thinks music is interesting but a little difficult. Grace and Eva had great fun there. Grace learned a lot about music. Also, the cookies smell wonderful.
Grace plays baseball with Eva every Tuesday. Grace bought a T-shirt at the shop yesterday. Life is full of small surprises. The sudden change of plans caused some confusion.
They took many photos at the supermarket. Grace usually has noodles for breakfast. Both of them like noodles and juice.
